description: We are a passionate multidisciplinary team from SBTU Rocket and Propulsion Society, launching as one of our club's inaugural competition squads! Our team combines Aircraft Engineering (Esra Acar, 4th yr; Mustafa Alp Karaviran, 3rd yr), Computer Engineering (Enes Aslantaş), and Chemical Engineering (İbrahim Şentürk, prep). Driven by space exploration, propulsion, and software, we turn bold ideas into working prototypes. Looking for teammates skilled in AI/Data Science, UI/UX, or Graphic Design.
